# Safety Checklist: Corpus Remediation Runner

**Purpose**: Validate that 010 requirements clearly specify dry-run no-write behavior, bounded confirmed execution, deterministic-only scope, and safety boundaries before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-07-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
